root_cause.text: The MCTP netlink response handlers for neighbor, address, and route messages did not zero-initialize the netlink message header structures (ndmsg, ifaddrmsg, rtmsg), leaving padding bytes uninitialized and leaking kernel memory to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `memset(hdr, 0, sizeof(*hdr))` before setting fields in `mctp_fill_neigh`, `mctp_fill_addrinfo`, and `mctp_fill_rtinfo`, as the CVE description states that "RTM_GETNEIGH will return uninitalised data in the pad bytes of the ndmsg data".
